description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify the appointments to the President's staff, Mr E. Weerakoon and two Others, w.e.f. 08.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notifications of specific personnel appointments (Mr. Esala Weerakoon, Mr. V. Mahendrarajah, Mrs. A. Vaidehi) to government positions (Senior Additional Secretary, Director, Assistant Director) with basic titles only. It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter assignments, making it a pure "People Gazette" according to the classification criteria.
